name: SambaNova Cloud free tier (ended)
amount: No free API use any more: a payment method and purchased credits are needed before the first request
summary: SambaNova's Free plan used to work without a card (with per-model daily limits and, until August 2026, $5 of free credit). Its plans page now says to add a payment method and purchase credits to run your first requests, and the API answers a key without a card with "A payment method is required" (our test, 2 Oct 2026). Its docs still describe a no-card free tier.
source_note: cloud.sambanova.ai/plans and a test request with a new no-card key (HTTP 402 PAYMENT_METHOD_REQUIRED), 2026-10-02. The rate-limits docs page still describes the old free tier.

changes.text: Free tier ended: SambaNova now needs a payment method and purchased credits before any API request.
